line Axis = polar(start: (430, -70), angle: 7, length: 33)
line Seed = polar(start: (-80, -40), angle: 7, length: 33)
arc First = arc(center: (0, 7), radius: 26, start: 287 + 0, end: 38 + 0, direction: counterclockwise)
move First as selected (from: (0, 0), to: (17, -9), angleDeg: 13)
move First as later (from: (0, 0), to: (17, -9), angleDeg: 31)
arc Second = arc(center: (140, 7), radius: 26, start: 287 + 29, end: 38 + 29, direction: counterclockwise)
move Second as selected (from: (0, 0), to: (17, -9), angleDeg: 13)
move Second as later (from: (0, 0), to: (17, -9), angleDeg: 31)
const paths: path[] = [@First.selected, @Second.selected]
module Select(paths: path[], pick: number) {
  export const out: path = @paths[@pick]
}
instance One = Select(paths: @paths, pick: 0)
instance Two = Select(paths: @paths, pick: 1)
const first: number = lineAngle(@One::out.start, @Axis.start)
const result: number = lineAngle(@Two::out.start, @Axis.start)

line Axis = polar(start: (430, -70), angle: 7, length: 33)

nui 1
line Axis = polar(start: (430, -70), angle: 7, length: 33)
line Seed = polar(start: (-80, -40), angle: 7, length: 33)
for i in range(min: 0, max: 1, step: 1) carry edge: path = @Seed carry bad: number = 9 {
  line Generated = polar(start: (@i * 120, 7), angle: 23 + @i * 11, length: 33)
  move Generated as selected (from: (0, 0), to: (17, -9), angleDeg: 13)
  move Generated as later (from: (0, 0), to: (17, -9), angleDeg: 31)
  next edge = @Generated[@bad].selected
  next bad = @bad
}
const Alias: path = @edge
const result: number = lineAngle(@Alias.start, @Axis.start)

line Seed = polar(start: (-80, -40), angle: 7, length: 33)

  line Generated = polar(start: (@i * 120, 7), angle: 23 + @i * 11, length: 33)
  move Generated as selected (from: (0, 0), to: (17, -9), angleDeg: 13)
  move Generated as later (from: (0, 0), to: (17, -9), angleDeg: 31)
  next edge = @Generated[@i].nonexistent
  next bad = @bad
}
const Alias: path = @edge
const result: number = lineAngle(@Alias.start, @Axis.start)

slots.source:
nui 1
line Axis = polar(start: (430, -70), angle: 7, length: 33)
line Seed = polar(start: (-80, -40), angle: 7, length: 33)
for i in range(min: 0, max: 1, step: 1) carry edge: path = @Seed carry bad: number = 9 {
  line Generated = polar(start: (@i * 120, 7), angle: 23 + @i * 11, length: 0)
  move Generated as selected (from: (0, 0), to: (17, -9), angleDeg: 13)
  move Generated as later (from: (0, 0), to: (17, -9), angleDeg: 31)
  next edge = @Generated[@i].selected
  next bad = @bad
}
const Alias: path = @edge
const result: number = lineAngle(@Alias.start, @Axis.start)

slots.source:
nui 1
line Axis = polar(start: (430, -70), angle: 7, length: 33)
line Seed = polar(start: (-80, -40), angle: 7, length: 33)
for i in range(min: 0, max: 1, step: 1) carry edge: path = @Seed carry bad: number = 9 {
  line Generated = polar(start: (@i * 120, 7), angle: 1 / 0, length: 33)
  move Generated as selected (from: (0, 0), to: (17, -9), angleDeg: 13)
  move Generated as later (from: (0, 0), to: (17, -9), angleDeg: 31)
  next edge = @Generated[@i].selected
  next bad = @bad
}
const Alias: path = @edge
const result: number = lineAngle(@Alias.start, @Axis.start)

adjacent.source:
nui 1
line Axis = polar(start: (430, -70), angle: 7, length: 33)
line Seed = polar(start: (-80, -40), angle: 7, length: 33)
for i in range(min: 0, max: 1, step: 1) carry edge: path = @Seed carry bad: number = 9 {
  line Generated = polar(start: (@i * 120, 7), angle: 23 + @i * 11, length: 33)
  move Generated as selected (from: (0, 0), to: (17, -9), angleDeg: 13)
  move Generated as later (from: (0, 0), to: (17, -9), angleDeg: 31)
  next edge = @Generated[@i].selected
  next bad = @bad
}
const Alias: path = @edge
const result: number = lineAngle(@Alias.start, @Axis.start)

adjacent.source:
nui 1
line Axis = polar(start: (430, -70), angle: 7, length: 33)
line Seed = polar(start: (-80, -40), angle: 7, length: 33)
for i in range(min: 0, max: 1, step: 1) carry edge: path = @Seed carry bad: number = 9 {
  line Generated = polar(start: (@i * 120, 7), angle: 23 + @i * 11, length: 33)
  move Generated as selected (from: (0, 0), to: (17, -9), angleDeg: 13)
  move Generated as later (from: (0, 0), to: (17, -9), angleDeg: 31)
  next edge = @Generated[@i].selected
  next bad = @bad
}
const Alias: path = @edge
const result: number = lineAngle(@Alias.start, @Axis.start)
